subject: MAP: onramp checkpoints & SOC 2 / SIG / DPA alignment
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: MAP kickoff — onramp checkpoints & evidence ask

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I sketched an initial mutual action plan (attached) that breaks the onramp into three security/compliance checkpoints we typically use for banking customers:

1) Intake & evidence exchange (SOC 2 summary, current SIG/CAIQ exports, proposed DPA redline)
2) Technical review & environment run (staging access, data residency verification, KV/retention plan)
3) Acceptance & contract close (finalized DPA, rolling SLA dates, escrow/escrow-ops if needed)

Quick asks to keep momentum:
- Can you share the preferred legal contact for DPA redlines (name + email)?
- Is First Harbor expecting EU data residency constraints for this pilot, or will US-only suffice for the PoC?
- Please upload your SIG matrix if you have one; otherwise we can run our SIG exporter and send a mapping.

I've attached the MAP draft and a short SOC 2 summary that outlines the controls we exercise in production — highlights include encryption at rest, role-based access, and audit logging retention. Neha will lead the technical evidence intake and Karthik will handle items that touch the DPA / legal carve-outs. Marissa (cc'd on the thread for visibility) will coordinate procurement timing once we have mutual acceptance criteria.

Proposed intake meeting: Tue May 11, 10:00 AM PT — happy to adjust.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

- Staging access: we'll request a temporary service account that can reach the staging endpoints. If First Harbor requires IP allowlist only, please provide the CIDR ranges.
- Data residency: for PoC we will keep processing in US-west. For EU residency later we support region pinning and can outline the operational steps.
- Evidence we will supply in next 48 hrs: SIG exporter (flattened), SOC 2 control mapping (control IDs -> our implementation notes), trace logs retention policy extract.

Attachment: I've uploaded a first-draft SIG inventory that maps CAIQ sections to our controls — this should speed the reviewer. If your security team prefers, we can convert it to their template.

Open items for First Harbor:
- Confirm whether redaction is required for sample payloads before we share example traces.
- Confirm expected retention windows per data class (see Hannah's note to Tom).

I'll attach the SIG inventory here for convenience.

Cheers,

Hi Elaine / Hannah —

Thanks for the fast turn. Based on today's intake and Neha's SIG inventory, here's a proposed close timeline and concrete deliverables we can commit to for the MAP:

Week 0 (May 11-14): Intake complete. First Harbor uploads SIG export; Redwood sends SOC 2 summary, SIG mappings, and retention summary.
Week 1 (May 17-21): Technical review — staging access + sample traces (redacted if requested). Security Q&A returned within 3 business days.
Week 2 (May 24-28): Legal & DPA — Redwood to upload DPA_Proposed_Redline.docx; Tom to share redline comments. We will aim for a single DPA iteration for the pilot.
Week 3 (May 31-Jun 4): Acceptance gating — finalize acceptance criteria, schedule go/no-go call, and (if applicable) finalize escrow/retention annex.

Action items for First Harbor:
- Tom: confirm whether a single DPA redline iteration is acceptable and provide any non-negotiable clauses (e.g., data subject rights timelines).
- Security team: confirm redaction requirements for sample payloads and upload any missing SIG artifacts.

I attached the DPA draft with inline comments in the DocuSign link; if Tom is OK we can route the redline through DocuSign after agreement on retention windows. Marissa will follow up on procurement timelines and PO requirements once the DPA path is clear.

Happy to tighten the schedule if you prefer.

— Karthik
VP, Solutions & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
